blocks.field21: The First World War and the return
blocks.field22: Albion declined wartime league football, then joined Aston Villa, Derby County and Wolves for the Midland Victory League in spring 1919. The club’s account describes six charity games before the Football League resumed in 1919/20. All six results are included: four crosschecked and two labelled single-source records, Derby away on 12 April (0–1) and Villa home on 19 April (5–1). The complete record is three wins, one draw and two defeats, goals 12–5, matching

blocks.field106: All eligible fixtures in the cited 1919 Victory League and 1939–46 seasonal lists are now included within this archive’s scope. “Listed fixtures included” describes coverage of those source lists, not independent confirmation of every result or a claim to include all football Albion ever played. The evidence breakdown distinguishes crosschecked and single-source records. Single-source scores are explicitly labelled and remain open to correction. Records without a usable date, score or first-team identification remain outside the table; any retained source discrepancy is stated in its row. Ordinary friendlies, reserve games, testimonials and interrupted matches without a standing result are not part of this collection.
